items.t: Lyophilised plasma, IV, 15mL/kg over 20-30 minutes.
Fresh Frozen Plasma, IV, 15mL/kg over 20-30 minutes. AND Discuss further management with a specialist.

dosing.h: Thrombotic Thrombocytopenic Purpura- Haemolytic Uraemic Syndrome (Ttp-hus)

items.t: Lyophilised plasma, IV infusion, 30 mL/kg/day in 3–4 divided doses.
Fresh frozen plasma, IV infusion, 30 mL/kg/day in 3–4 divided doses.
Lyophilised plasma, IV, 15 mL/kg as initial dose. · Volume: ±200 mL/unit.
Fresh frozen plasma, IV, 15 mL/kg as initial dose. · Volume: ±280 mL/unit.
Lyophilised plasma, IV, 15 mL/kg.
Fresh Frozen Plasma, IV, 15 mL/kg.
Lyophilised plasma, IV, 2 units.
Lyophilised plasma, IV. · 1 unit for each unit of emergency blood transfused. Arrange urgent transfer to a centre with blood bank and specialist services.
Lyophilised plasma (FDP), IV, 15 mL/kg over 20-30 minutes. Lyophilised plasma contains a minimum of 0.4 units/mL of each coagulation factor.
Fresh Frozen Plasma (FFP), IV, 15 mL/kg over 20-30 minutes.
Freeze-dried plasma, IV, 15 mL/kg immediately. · Repeat dose if the patient’s clinical response and/or the coagulation function testing results indicate continued need.
Freeze-dried plasma, IV, 1 unit immediately. · Should be given for every unit of red blood cells when it is anticipated that >4 units of red blood cells will be required.
Lyophilised plasma, IV, 20 mL/kg.
Fresh frozen plasma, IV, 20 mL/kg.
Lyophilised plasma (FDP), IV, 20 mL/kg over 20-30 minutes. Lyophilised plasma contains a minimum of 0.4 units/mL of each coagulation factor.
Fresh frozen plasma (FFP), IV, 10 - 15 mL/kg over 20-30 minutes.
Lyophilised plasma (fresh dried plasma), IV, 20 mL/kg administered over 2 hours.
Fresh frozen plasma, IV, 20 mL/kg administered over 2 hours.

dosing.h: Thrombotic Thrombocytopenic Purpura/ Haemolytic Uraemic Syndrome

items.t: Freeze dried plasma (FDP), IV, 30 mL/kg/day over 20-30 minutes in 3–4 doses.
Fresh frozen plasma (FFP), IV, 30 mL/kg/day over 20-30 minutes in 3– 4 doses.
Fresh frozen plasma or lyophilised plasma, IV, 20 mL/kg over 1 hour.

cautions.t: Freeze-dried plasma is reconstituted with the supplied water and needs no thawing

adverse_effects.t: Transfusion reactions, TRALI, circulatory overload, infection risk (very low)
